alerts.label: Morning summary
alerts.description: One push at 9 AM with what needs attention today: critical vendors, orders due, loss watch, Fix Issues items back, inventory upload, yesterday's sales and open checks - only the parts you can open.

alerts.label: Order due
alerts.description: A vendor order is due today or tomorrow (from the Vendor Calendar). Also a line in the Morning summary; turn this on for a separate push per vendor.

alerts.label: Critical vendors
alerts.description: Vendors with items about to run out, at 9 AM. Also a line in the Morning summary.

alerts.label: Closing checklist
alerts.description: A closing checklist hasn't been submitted by 9:30 PM.

alerts.label: Invoice failed to send
alerts.description: An invoice you submitted couldn't be sent by WhatsApp or to Toast (admins: anyone's).

alerts.label: Open checks (opening, 4 PM, day end)
alerts.description: Checks still open at 9 AM, new checks still open at 4 PM, and a day-end summary at 9:30 PM. The 9 AM count is also a line in the Morning summary.

alerts.label: Task assigned
alerts.description: A task was assigned to you or your team.

alerts.label: Task overdue
alerts.description: A task of yours is overdue (an hour past its due time).

alerts.label: Task due in 30 minutes
alerts.description: A reminder 30 minutes before a task of yours is due.

alerts.label: Fix Issues task reminders
alerts.description: Due-soon and overdue reminders for your daily Fix Issues task (the task itself still arrives as Task assigned).

alerts.label: Task can't be done
alerts.description: Someone marked a task you assigned as "can't do".

alerts.label: Task done
alerts.description: A task you gave someone was finished.

alerts.label: Task comments
alerts.description: Someone commented on a task you made or are assigned.

alerts.label: Announcements
alerts.description: A manager posts an announcement to your team, or reminds you to read one.

alerts.label: Fix Issues items back
alerts.description: Items closed for more time (one week) that still show the problem and are open again. One push a day; also a line in the Morning summary.

alerts.label: Cart removal requests
alerts.description: Someone asked to remove an item from the purchase order cart (admins only).

alerts.label: Chat messages
alerts.description: New messages in your team chats and direct messages (muted chats only for @mentions).

alerts.label: Flyer sent
alerts.description: A flyer you sent has gone out to its WhatsApp groups (or some groups failed).

alerts.label: Inventory upload due
alerts.description: The last inventory file is too old (7 days by default) - upload one to refresh costs and vendor codes. 9 AM; also a line in the Morning summary (admins only).

alerts.label: Loss watch
alerts.description: Checks to review from yesterday: a full comp, a large discount, refund or void, something unusual for that employee, or a check open too long or changed after payment. 9 AM; also a line in the Morning summary (admins only).

alerts.label: Yesterday's sales
alerts.description: Yesterday's net sales from Toast, compared with the same day last week and the 4-week average. 9 AM; also a line in the Morning summary (not sent to accounts with sales numbers hidden).

alerts.label: Inventory from Toast ready
alerts.description: Toast's inventory matched the daily file enough nights in a row (7 by default) - time to turn on Inventory from Toast. Once, at 9 AM; also a line in the Morning summary (admins only).

alerts.label: Chat mentions
alerts.description: Someone @mentions you in a team chat or a direct message - even in a chat you muted.

groups.label: Needs action
groups.description: Something for you to do now.

groups.label: Team
groups.description: People talking to you: chat, @mentions, announcements.

groups.label: Daily summary
groups.description: The 9 AM Morning summary, or any of its parts as a separate push.
